unit: an ORF of a holdout contig, with the coordinates the drawing needs
question: where on each contig its genes sit, so the page can draw the molecule instead of a bar chart of its identities
identities_are_not_measured_here: every identity, subject, role and E-value is read from conserved_positions_s1.json and joined by ORF index; this script calls ORFs and nothing else, and raises if the two disagree about an ORF's length
truth_note: the withheld genome was deposited after the index cutoff this cascade was rolled back to, so its distance is a fact nobody in this project chose

blind_spots: a called ORF is a prediction, in meta mode, on a contig that is itself an assembly; a gene drawn here is where the caller put it
an ORF with no significant alignment is drawn unlabelled rather than as absent, because no search here can distinguish a novel gene from a wrong call
the withheld contig covers 96% of the deposited genome, so a gene near either end may be truncated by the assembly rather than by biology

reached_the_unidentified_pile is a membership test against one run directory's contigs.jsonl, which holds the unidentified pile. False means the cascade identified and subtracted the contig; it does not say at what score, which results/holdout_cascade/REPORT.md records
